method: All272 real current PNGs inspected through20 labelled HTML/Compose base comparisons and58 four-config state contact sheets. Approved tokens/inventory govern states the simplified HTML does not model. No source edits by reviewer. Platform fonts/system chrome and fixture data variation excluded; actual shape/color/identity/context deviations retained.

elements.note: Surface header names Choose a space with DATA SEARCH eyebrow and directional Back; differences in duplicate body heading/system chrome are platform presentation.
Localized space ownership supporting copy is visible.
Existing accessible-space rows and continued paging are visible; data authorization remains separate QA.
Full-width bordered surface rows now include secondary-container space glyph, name and confirmed counts.
Load more is visible for fixture cursor.
Amber review note now carries the approved attention role.
No-space panel blocks entry and offers Refresh/Return home, but uses default lavender Card and pill safe-action buttons instead of approved surface/outline and 12dp actions.
Offline/permission/session hide protected names and provide safe Back/Refresh, but all use generic neutral Card instead of amber offline/error failure roles.
Conversation header now includes document/source glyph, conversations, Back, title and selected-space identity.
Exact pinned-source count is visible; differing selected scope is fixture content.
Ordered transcript and Load older are visible.
User bubble uses primaryContainer with role/time/delivery text.
Assistant now has secondary start edge and distinct surface; Markdown/code/link/copy are visible.
Streaming and isolated sending cases expose one active indicator and written state; token announcements cannot be established by still images.
Isolated interrupted case preserves errorContainer partial answer and explicit incomplete/manual reconciliation text.
Structured reference chip is visibly below assistant body for explicitly enabled fixture.
Composer remains visible but field has near-square default corners instead of approved 12dp/15dp input shape; IME and draft persistence are not image proof.
Send is a circular control instead of approved rounded-square action shape; disabled states have adjacent text and ample visible target.
Empty invitation and composer exist, but generic lavender card omits the approved centered RAG-avatar identity.

Conversation name label stays visible for populated/empty field.

Selected-space supporting copy visible.

Cancel precedes Create/Save in reading order but uses pill rather than 12dp shape.
Create/Save remain primary and blank-name Create disabled; ordinary action corners remain pill.

Error preserves title, but displays implementation-conditional 'Validation and service failures keep...' instead of concrete failure; blank-name validation has no inline explanation. Global permission/session/offline panels use neutral instead of approved state roles.
